name: @kiwa/streaming
description: Streaming test adapter for kiwa — Kafka (kafkajs API 互換 producer / consumer / admin) + Redpanda (Kafka API 互換 + schema-registry client) + NATS (nats.js API 互換 + JetStream + KV / Object Store) unified mock, with 5 base semantics (producer / consumer / exactly-once / DLQ / schema-registry) + 8 advanced-semantics axes (Kafka raw protocol + consumer group + Redpanda schema evolution + transactions + NATS JetStream durable + KV/Object + cross-provider exactly-once + consumer lag telemetry) + 3 provider × 8 axis fidelity harness

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
scripts.test:cov: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --coverage --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/**/*.js' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/tests/**' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/src/index.js'
